contenders.handicapper_notes: Undefeated over 1400m (2-for-2 at the trip). Drops to a featherweight 55.0kg and draws ideally in barrier 2 to stalk the speed on Taree tight bends. Excellent 4th at Coffs Harbour against stronger Class 2 opposition last start and rates as the clear top selection.

Provincial-trained mare from the Kristen Buchanan stable who won a BM66 at Muswellbrook two starts back leading throughout. Possesses decisive early speed (E) to control the race from barrier 5. Effective weight at 58.5kg is manageable in this grade.

Provincial shipper dropping back in class from Wyong and Kembla Grange Midweek BM64/BM68 company. Drawn favorably in barrier 4 where she will enjoy a soft midfield run (S) and produce a potent late finish on the Kikuyu turf.

Local galloper who rarely runs a bad race over 1400m at Taree. Gets massive weight relief carrying just 55.0kg from low gate 3. Solid 3rd behind I Am Steffi two back over this track and distance stamps him as a major threat.

Ran a blinder when 5th beaten just 1.5 lengths in the $25k Open Handicap Hopkinson Liver over 1400m at this track on August 14. Drops significantly in grade to Class 3, but is burdened by top weight (60.0kg) and wide barrier 10.

Proven 1400m performer with 2 wins at the distance, including a gritty BM58 victory at Grafton two starts back. Awkward draw in barrier 12 will force a patient ride from the back (S), but can run into the placings late.

contenders.handicapper_notes: Ideal low draw (barrier 2) perfectly exploits Taree inside speed bias over the 1000m scamper. Exits an excellent runner-up performance in Bm66 company at Bathurst over 1100m when beaten just 0.3L. Maps to stalk the leading speed in the box-seat and possesses the superior class and finishing punch under 63.0kg minus apprentice claim.

Brings strong Provincial formlines, having won a Gosford Class 1 over 1000m on wet ground three runs back before competing in competitive Wyong BM64 events. Wide gate requires early work, but he has the tactical speed and class drop to be right in the finish.

Sharp front-runner with legitimate early boot. Narrowly missed when second over 1200m at Port Macquarie on a heavy track last week carrying 63.0kg. Back to 1000m suits his high-cruising speed and Jenny Duggan takes over in the saddle.

Bounced back into the winner circle with a tough victory over 1000m at Port Macquarie on August 22 carrying 62.0kg. Proven wet-tracker who handles testing surfaces and will be strong through the line despite the wide starting stall.

First-up specialist who won consecutive BM58 races at Port Macquarie and Tamworth over 1000m before spelling. Jockey alteration to Anna Roper is a big plus; maps for a sweet stalking trip from gate 6.

Experienced campaigner who excels at Taree (18 starts for 9 placings) and loves soft/heavy tracks. Gets a 1.5kg weight relief with Grady Spokes and draws gate 3 to save ground throughout. Genuine danger at big odds if the front-runners over-cook the early splits.
